title: Fine-tuning Large Language Models: A Brief Introduction
abstract: Introduction Large Language Models (LLMs), usually trained with extensive text data, can demonstrate remarkable capabilities in handling various tasks with state-of-the-art performance. However, people nowadays typically want something more personalised instead of a general solution. For example, one may want LLMs to assist in code writing while the other may seek models that are specialised in medical knowledge.
